---
title: "Playground"
subtitle: "Every atlas in the ggsegverse, and the code behind every figure"
toc: false
page-layout: full
include-after-body:
  - text: |
      <script>
        // The app is given its src here rather than in the markup so it loads
        // once, already matching this page's colour mode. Later toggles are
        // sent across instead of reloading it.
        (function () {
          const frame = document.querySelector("iframe.playground-frame");
          if (!frame || !frame.dataset.src) return;

          const mode = () =>
            document.body.classList.contains("quarto-dark") ? "dark" : "light";

          const url = new URL(frame.dataset.src);
          url.searchParams.set("embed", "1");
          url.searchParams.set("mode", mode());
          frame.src = url.toString();

          new MutationObserver(() => {
            if (!frame.contentWindow) return;
            frame.contentWindow.postMessage(
              { type: "ggsegverse-set-mode", mode: mode() },
              new URL(frame.dataset.src).origin
            );
          }).observe(document.body, {
            attributes: true,
            attributeFilter: ["class"]
          });
        })();
      </script>
---

Pick an atlas, change how it is drawn, and the R code under the figure is
rewritten to match. The app renders each figure by running that code, so
anything you copy out of it runs unchanged in your own session.

<iframe
  class="playground-frame"

  loading="eager">
</iframe>

::: {.playground-note}
The app runs on [Posit Connect Cloud](https://connect.posit.cloud) and takes a
moment to wake up on first load; 3D brains take a few seconds more while their
meshes load. If the frame stays empty, open it directly at
[drmowinckels-ggsegverse-demo.share.connect.posit.cloud](https://drmowinckels-ggsegverse-demo.share.connect.posit.cloud).
The source is on [GitHub](https://github.com/ggsegverse/demo).
:::
